subject: Request: Hosted API vulnerability assessment and secure exchange options
messages:
From: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@nebulahealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Team <security@nebulahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Hosted API vulnerability assessment and secure exchange options

Hi Chloe,

We're preparing for an upcoming SOC 2 control assessment and our auditors have asked for the most recent penetration/vulnerability assessment for Redwood's Hosted API environment. Can you share the latest report (full technical findings) or suggest a secure way for us to review it?

A few specifics from our side:
- We need the scope clearly stated for the Hosted API (to confirm multi-tenant vs. dedicated/private exclusions).
- If possible, we prefer a secure reviewer portal or a presigned download link with short expiry.
- If there's any PII or customer data in the report that needs redaction, please let us know what will be redacted.
- Our SOC 2 audit window is the week of 2026-11-22; ideally we'd have access before then.

Can you confirm options and an ETA? If needed we can sign an NDA or a short MAA.

Thanks,
Alex Jordan
Head of Security, Nebula Health
alex.jordan@nebulahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 13:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API vulnerability assessment and secure exchange options

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the heads up and the SOC 2 window. We can absolutely accommodate review of our most recent external penetration test. High-level options for secure delivery:

1) Secure reviewer portal (preferred) — we create a one-time reviewer account scoped to Nebula Health, with 30-day read-only access and download disabled by default. We can enable download for vetted contacts.
2) Presigned S3 object — 72-hour expiry + password-protected ZIP (shared over a separate channel).
3) Encrypted PGP archive — we can encrypt with your public key if you provide it.
4) Executive summary (redacted) — immediate delivery via email; full report via portal after MAA/NDA as needed.

Scope clarification: the assessment (conducted Aug 2026 by independent vendor RedRock Security) covers Redwood Hosted API runtime and control plane components used by our hosted offering. It explicitly excludes: Dedicated (reserved hardware) and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments, as well as customer data stores. The report includes: test plan, vulnerability findings with CVSS/priority, PoC notes (redacted in shared copies), and a remediation timeline.

Suggested next steps:
- If you can confirm preferred delivery method (portal vs presigned link) and which reviewers need access, we will provision access and share instructions.
- If your legal team requires a short MAA/NDA, send it over and we'll get legal to review (turnaround ~1 business day).
- We can provide an executive summary immediately while the secure copy is prepared.

Tentative ETA: exec summary within 24 hours; secure-portal invite or presigned package within 48–72 hours after access method is confirmed.

I'll loop in Marcus (security ops) and Priya (privacy/compliance) to provide remediation status and any redacted artifacts.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive — Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0199

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@nebulahealth.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API vulnerability assessment and secure exchange options

On Mon, Nov 9, 2026 at 1:04 PM Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> If you can confirm preferred delivery method (portal vs presigned link) and which reviewers need access, we will provision access and share instructions.

Alex — quick background from security ops: the Aug 2026 assessment produced 18 findings (3 high, 5 medium, 10 low). Current remediation status (summary):

- High (3): 2 remediated and verified in staging; 1 under mitigation (ETA 2026-11-19).
- Medium (5): 4 remediated; 1 scheduled for configuration update (ETA 2026-11-16).
- Low (10): all scheduled in maintenance windows — tracking complete.

We can attach an executive summary PDF and a remediation tracker CSV with the above dispositions. Full technical PoCs contain exploit traces and are redacted by default when we share externally; we can provide PoCs under a secured NDA and portal access.

Portal logistics: once Chloe confirms, I will: provision Nebula reviewer accounts, upload the redacted full report to the portal, and attach the remediation tracker. Access will be logged — we can provide audit entries for your SOC evidence pack.

Stubs (attachments to be included with portal or presigned package):
- redwood_pt_exec_summary_2026.pdf (exec summary, redacted PoC sections)
- remediation_tracker_nov2026.csv (finding id, severity, status, ETA, owner)

Link to internal remediation tracker (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodRemediationTracker

If Nebula prefers the presigned option we will create an S3 object with a signed URL and send password over an out-of-band channel.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@nebulahealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Team <security@nebulahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API vulnerability assessment and secure exchange options

Chloe / Marcus —

Thanks for the clarity. We prefer option #1 (secure reviewer portal) so we can limit distribution and capture access logs for our SOC 2 evidence. Please provision two reviewer accounts for myself and our lead auditor (emailed to security@nebulahealth.com).

A couple of asks to include in the portal invite:
- Access should be read-only with download disabled; if download is required we will request it and sign an MAA.
- Please include the exec summary PDF and the remediation tracker CSV in the portal.
- Can you confirm the ETA for the pending high finding remediation verification? Our auditor will want a snapshot of the status as of 2026-11-19.

If you can provision access by EOD Monday (2026-11-15) that gives us time to validate before the audit week.

We will be available on a short discovery call if you prefer to walk through the tracker — propose Tue 11/16 10:00 AM PT.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alex Jordan
Head of Security, Nebula Health
